layers.title: Shared contracts
layers.one_line: The formats and interfaces several subprojects agree on: LLVM IR, bitcode, the pass manager interface, TableGen, profile data, MLIR core IR and libc's shared headers

layers.title: LLVM core
layers.one_line: Analyses, transforms, code generation, MC, backends, object/debug info, JIT, LTO and the support libraries

layers.title: Frontends
layers.one_line: Clang (C-family) and Flang (Fortran): source to LLVM IR or to MLIR

layers.title: MLIR
layers.one_line: Dialects, rewriting and conversion, translation to LLVM IR, bindings

layers.title: Runtimes
layers.one_line: Libraries linked into compiled programs: compiler-rt, libc, libc++, flang-rt, offload/OpenMP

layers.title: Project, build and testing
layers.one_line: Community policy, the CMake/runtimes build and the lit/FileCheck testing infrastructure

components.title: LLVM IR (LangRef)
components.one_line: The in-memory, textual and semantic definition of LLVM IR: types, instructions, intrinsics, metadata, attributes. Every frontend writes it and every pass reads it.
evidence: offload/plugins-nextgen/common/src/JIT.cpp:22 includes llvm/IR/LLVMContext.h (device IR handled at run time)
llvm/lib/IR/DebugInfoMetadata.cpp (debug metadata is part of the IR)

components.title: LLVM bitcode format
components.one_line: The binary serialization of LLVM IR (bitstream container, block/record layout); the format LTO, -fembed-bitcode, offload images and the linkers exchange.
evidence: lld/ELF, lld/COFF, lld/MachO, lld/wasm CMakeLists link BitReader/BitWriter (via LTO)
23 llvm/tools CMakeLists link BitReader or BitWriter (llvm-bcanalyzer, llvm-dis, llvm-as, ...)
llvm/lib/Bitstream (container shared with clang serialized diagnostics and remarks)

components.title: Pass manager interface (new PM, PassBuilder)
components.one_line: PassBuilder, the new pass manager and its analysis-manager protocol, plus the pipeline text format: the interface every optimizer driver (clang, flang, opt, LTO, the offload JIT) builds pipelines through.
evidence: clang/lib/CodeGen/BackendUtil.cpp:46 includes llvm/Passes/PassBuilder.h; :632,:660 register callbacks on PassBuilder
lld/ELF, lld/COFF, lld/MachO, lld/wasm CMakeLists link Passes

components.title: TableGen (language, llvm-tblgen and the per-project backends)
components.one_line: The record-description language and its library; llvm-tblgen generates instruction selectors, register info, intrinsics and options, and clang-tblgen, mlir-tblgen and lldb-tblgen are separate backends built on the same library.
evidence: llvm/include/llvm/Option/OptParser.td (driver options for clang, flang, lld, tools)

components.title: Profile and coverage data formats
components.one_line: Instrumentation profile (raw/indexed), sample profile, MemProf and coverage-mapping formats; written by the compiler-rt runtime, read by the compiler and by llvm-profdata/llvm-cov.
evidence: compiler-rt/include/profile/InstrProfData.inc is byte-identical to llvm/include/llvm/ProfileData/InstrProfData.inc (cmp); header says it is shared by runtime, instrumentation and tools

components.title: libc shared headers and the GPU RPC protocol
components.one_line: Header-only pieces of LLVM libc exported for other projects: the GPU-to-host RPC protocol and server, and freestanding math/float parsing. Six projects outside libc include them.
evidence: offload/plugins-nextgen/common/src/RPC.cpp:16-18 includes shared/rpc.h, rpc_opcodes.h, rpc_server.h; offload/plugins-nextgen/common/CMakeLists.txt:36-38 links llvm-libc-common-utilities
flang-rt/CMakeLists.txt:62 and flang-rt/cmake/modules/AddFlangRT.cmake (RPC for GPU I/O)

components.title: MLIR core: IR, ODS, interfaces and pass infrastructure
components.one_line: Operations, regions, attributes, types, traits and interfaces, the ODS/TableGen way of defining dialects, the pass manager and the bytecode format; the contract every dialect, Flang FIR and Clang CIR are written against.
evidence: mlir/tools/mlir-tblgen + mlir/lib/TableGen generate ops from ODS
clang/lib/FrontendTool/CMakeLists.txt links MLIRIR MLIRPass when CLANG_ENABLE_CIR

components.title: LLVM analyses
components.one_line: Alias analysis, MemorySSA, loop/cycle/uniformity info, scalar evolution, cost models, ML-guided advisors and optimization remarks; read by every transform.

components.title: LLVM transforms (the middle-end optimizer)
components.one_line: Scalar, IPO, InstCombine, coroutine, vectorizer (loop, SLP, VPlan, SandboxIR) and instrumentation passes; the instrumentation passes are the compiler half of every sanitizer and profiler.
evidence: llvm/lib/Transforms/Instrumentation/AddressSanitizer.cpp:139-140 emits calls to __asan_report_* / __asan_register_globals implemented in compiler-rt/lib/asan
clang/lib/CodeGen/CMakeLists.txt LINK_COMPONENTS IPO InstCombine Instrumentation ScalarOpts TransformUtils Coroutines

components.title: Target-independent code generator (SelectionDAG, MIR, register allocation, AsmPrinter)
components.one_line: Lowers IR to machine instructions: SelectionDAG and FastISel, MachineIR and its text format (MIR), scheduling, register allocation, stack maps/statepoints, DWARF emission via AsmPrinter.

components.title: GlobalISel
components.one_line: The second instruction selector: IRTranslator, Legalizer, RegBankSelect and InstructionSelect over generic MIR, with TableGen-imported SelectionDAG patterns; AArch64, AMDGPU, RISC-V and others use it.

components.title: MC layer (assembler, disassembler, object streamers)
components.one_line: Machine-code layer: MCInst, assembler parser, object writers for ELF/COFF/Mach-O/Wasm/XCOFF, disassembler and llvm-mca scheduling model consumers; shared by codegen, llvm-mc, lld and lldb.

components.title: Target backends (X86, AArch64, ARM, RISC-V, NVPTX, SPIR-V, DirectX, ...)
components.one_line: One backend per architecture under llvm/lib/Target, each a TableGen description plus lowering, ISel and MC pieces. DirectX and SPIR-V are the HLSL targets; NVPTX and AMDGPU the GPU offload targets.
evidence: llvm/lib/Target/DirectX/DXILRootSignature.cpp and DXILCBufferAccess.cpp include llvm/Frontend/HLSL (shared with clang)

components.title: AMDGPU backend
components.one_line: The AMD GPU backend: the most documented target, with its own memory model, DWARF extensions for heterogeneous debugging and assembler syntax reference; the code generator for HIP, OpenMP offload and libc GPU builds.

components.title: Object files and binary formats
components.one_line: Readers/writers for ELF, COFF, Mach-O, Wasm, XCOFF, archives and offload binaries, plus ObjectYAML (yaml2obj) and BinaryFormat; consumed by binutils replacements, lld, lldb and the offload tooling.
evidence: 46 CMakeLists under llvm/tools and 41 under llvm/lib link Object

components.title: Debug information (IR metadata to DWARF/PDB, readers and symbolizer)
components.one_line: Debug info end to end: how passes preserve IR debug metadata and debug records, DWARF/CodeView emission, and the DWARF, PDB/MSF, GSYM readers and symbolizer that llvm-dwarfdump, llvm-symbolizer, lld and lldb use.
evidence: compiler-rt sanitizers symbolize through llvm-symbolizer (Symbolize lib)

components.title: Support library and ADT
components.one_line: ADT containers, Support (command line, file system, error handling, RTTI helpers, YAML I/O, threading), Option parsing, CAS and Telemetry; linked by every C++ component in the monorepo.

components.title: JIT: ORC, JITLink, MCJIT
components.one_line: The just-in-time compilation stack: ORC layers and LLJIT, the JITLink linker, legacy MCJIT/RuntimeDyld; hosted by lli, clang-repl, lldb expression evaluation and the MLIR ExecutionEngine. The ORC runtime lives in compiler-rt/lib/orc and orc-rt.

components.title: Link-time optimization (LTO, ThinLTO, DTLTO, FatLTO)
components.one_line: Regular and Thin LTO drivers, the C API used by ld64 and the gold plugin, distributed ThinLTO; the linkers (lld) and the offload linker wrapper run the optimizer through it.
evidence: lld/ELF, lld/COFF, lld/MachO, lld/wasm CMakeLists link LTO
clang/lib/CodeGen/CMakeLists.txt LINK_COMPONENTS LTO (ThinLTO backend in BackendUtil.cpp)

components.title: Frontend support library (OpenMP/OpenACC IR builders, HLSL, offloading)
components.one_line: Language-runtime lowering shared by the three frontends: OpenMPIRBuilder and directive tables, OpenACC, HLSL resource/root-signature helpers, offloading image packaging, and the shared driver helpers.
evidence: FrontendOpenMP linked by 13 clang/lib, 4 flang/lib, 1 mlir/lib and 3 offload CMakeLists

components.title: Clang frontend: Lex, Parse, Sema
components.one_line: Preprocessor, parser and semantic analysis for C, C++, Objective-C, OpenCL, CUDA/HIP, SYCL, OpenMP/OpenACC and HLSL; diagnostics and language extensions are defined here (with clang/lib/Basic).
evidence: clang/lib/Frontend/CMakeLists.txt LINK_LIBS clangLex clangParse clangSema clangSerialization

components.title: Clang AST
components.one_line: The typed AST, its visitors, the constant expression interpreter (ByteCode), name mangling and the AST importer; the data structure Sema builds and everything after it reads.
evidence: lldb/source/Plugins/TypeSystem/Clang/CMakeLists.txt:17 links clangAST (LLDB keeps target types as a Clang AST)

components.title: Clang modules, PCH and AST serialization
components.one_line: Reading and writing AST files: precompiled headers, Clang modules and C++20 standard modules, plus module dependency scanning.
evidence: lldb/source/Plugins/TypeSystem/Clang/CMakeLists.txt:22 links clangSerialization (clang modules in the debugger)

components.title: Clang analysis library (CFG, dataflow, thread safety, lifetime safety)
components.one_line: Source-level analyses over the AST: CFG, the dataflow framework, thread-safety analysis, lifetime safety and unsafe-buffer-usage; run as compiler warnings by Sema and used by the static analyzer and clang-tidy.

components.title: Clang Static Analyzer and Scalable Static Analysis
components.one_line: The path-sensitive symbolic-execution analyzer with its checkers and cross-TU support, plus the newer summary-based Scalable Static Analysis (clang-ssaf-* tools).

components.title: Clang CodeGen (AST to LLVM IR) and the backend driver
components.one_line: Emits LLVM IR from the AST for every language and ABI, then runs the optimizer and backend through PassBuilder in BackendUtil.cpp; also emits coverage mapping and inserts sanitizer/CFI instrumentation hooks.
evidence: clang/lib/CodeGen/CMakeLists.txt LLVM_LINK_COMPONENTS (Core, Passes, IPO, Instrumentation, FrontendOpenMP, FrontendHLSL, LTO, ProfileData, BitWriter ...)

components.title: ClangIR (CIR): Clang to an MLIR dialect
components.one_line: An alternative Clang code generator that emits the CIR MLIR dialect from the AST, transforms it, and lowers it to the LLVM dialect and LLVM IR; the bridge that makes Clang an MLIR client.
evidence: clang/lib/CIR/CMakeLists.txt includes ${LLVM_MAIN_SRC_DIR}/../mlir/include; links MLIRCIR MLIRArithDialect MLIRLLVMDialect

components.title: Clang driver and offload toolchain
components.one_line: The clang/clang-cl/flang driver: toolchains per OS and target, multilib, sanitizer runtime selection, and the offload compilation pipeline (offload bundler, linker wrapper, NV/SYCL link wrappers). The flang driver is a toolchain here.
evidence: clang/lib/Driver/CMakeLists.txt LINK_COMPONENTS BinaryFormat MC Object Option ProfileData
clang/lib/Driver/ToolChains/Flang.cpp (flang is driven by the clang driver library)

components.title: Clang tooling: LibTooling, libclang, ASTMatchers, clang-format, clang-repl
components.one_line: The library surface for tools built on Clang: LibTooling and compilation databases, ASTMatchers and Transformer, the stable libclang C API, clang-format (lib/Format), plugins and the clang-repl interpreter; clangd and clang-tidy in clang-tools-extra build on it.

components.title: Flang frontend: driver, parser, semantics, module files
components.one_line: Fortran preprocessing, the parser-combinator parser and parse tree, name resolution, semantic checks, expression folding (Evaluate) and .mod files; driven by flang-new through the clang driver library.
evidence: flang/lib/Frontend/CMakeLists.txt LINK_COMPONENTS Passes Analysis BitReader Option FrontendDriver
flang/lib/Decimal (binary/decimal conversion, also compiled into flang-rt by path)

components.title: Flang lowering and FIR/HLFIR (MLIR dialects)
components.one_line: Lowers the Flang parse tree to the FIR and HLFIR MLIR dialects (flang/lib/Lower), optimizes them, and converts to the MLIR LLVM dialect; generates calls into the flang-rt runtime API.
evidence: flang/lib/Lower/CMakeLists.txt LINK_LIBS FIRDialect HLFIRDialect FortranSemantics FortranEvaluate MLIRFuncDialect MLIRLLVMDialect
flang/lib/Optimizer/Builder/Runtime/Character.cpp:14 includes flang/Runtime/character.h (runtime API headers in flang/include/flang/Runtime)
flang/lib/Lower/OpenMP uses the MLIR OpenMP dialect, translated by mlir/lib/Target/LLVMIR via OpenMPIRBuilder

components.title: Flang runtime (flang-rt)
components.one_line: The Fortran runtime library: I/O, descriptors, type info, intrinsics, the parallel multi-image runtime; built with the runtimes build, including for GPUs, against the API declared in flang/include/flang/Runtime.
evidence: flang-rt/lib/runtime/CMakeLists.txt:37-38 compiles ${FLANG_SOURCE_DIR}/lib/Decimal/*.cpp (sources shared by path, not by library)
flang-rt/CMakeLists.txt:62 libc RPC utilities for GPU I/O; :92 link against LLVM libc/libc++

components.title: MLIR dialects
components.one_line: The in-tree dialects (builtin, func, arith, affine, linalg, tensor/memref, vector, gpu, NVVM/ROCDL, LLVM, OpenMP, OpenACC, SPIR-V, TOSA, transform, IRDL, ...) and bufferization.

components.title: MLIR rewriting, conversion and tools
components.one_line: Pattern rewriting (C++ patterns, DRR, PDL/PDLL), canonicalization, dialect conversion and the Conversion/ passes between dialects, plus mlir-opt, mlir-reduce, mlir-rewrite and the LSP servers.

components.title: MLIR to LLVM IR translation and execution
components.one_line: Translates the LLVM, NVVM, ROCDL and OpenMP dialects to LLVM IR (and imports LLVM IR back), using OpenMPIRBuilder for OpenMP; the MLIR ExecutionEngine JITs the result with ORC.

components.title: MLIR C API and Python bindings
components.one_line: The stable C API (mlir/lib/CAPI) and the Python bindings built on it, through which out-of-tree users drive MLIR.

components.title: compiler-rt: builtins, sanitizer and profiling runtimes
components.one_line: Runtime halves of compiler features: builtins, the sanitizer runtimes (ASan, HWASan, MSan, TSan, UBSan, DFSan, CSan, RTSan, TySan, LSan, CFI, SafeStack), libFuzzer, XRay, Scudo/GWP-ASan, memprof and the profile runtime, plus the ORC runtime.
evidence: compiler-rt/lib/fuzzer/CMakeLists.txt:141-161 builds a private libc++ for libFuzzer

components.title: LLVM libc
components.one_line: A C standard library built from per-function entrypoints, usable in overlay or full-build mode, for Linux, baremetal, UEFI and GPUs (where it provides printf/malloc via RPC to the host).
evidence: libc/shared re-exports internal pieces to other projects
runtimes/CMakeLists.txt builds libc as a runtime

components.title: libc++ (with libc++abi and libunwind)
components.one_line: The C++ standard library, its ABI library and unwinder; ABI-versioned, hardened, with modules support; uses libc/shared for floating-point parsing.

components.title: Offload runtime (liboffload, libomptarget, OpenMP runtime)
components.one_line: The device-offloading runtime: liboffload API, libomptarget, per-vendor plugins (AMDGPU, CUDA, host) with a run-time JIT for device IR, the RPC server for device-side libc, and the OpenMP host/device runtime in openmp/.
evidence: offload/plugins-nextgen/common/src/JIT.cpp:20-30 includes llvm/CodeGen, llvm/Passes/PassBuilder.h (device IR compiled at run time)
offload/libomptarget and offload/liboffload CMakeLists link FrontendOpenMP

components.title: LLVM command-line tools
components.one_line: opt, llc, lli, llvm-mc, the binutils replacements (llvm-objdump, llvm-nm, llvm-ar, llvm-objcopy, ...), profile and coverage tools, llvm-reduce, llvm-exegesis, dsymutil and the rest of llvm/tools.
evidence: 46 llvm/tools CMakeLists link Object; 23 link BitReader/BitWriter; 14 link DebugInfoDWARF

components.title: LLDB debugger core and plugins
components.one_line: The debugger engine: targets, processes, breakpoints, symbol files, data formatters, the gdb-remote protocol and lldb-server, platforms, and a Clang-based expression evaluator and type system.
evidence: lldb/source/Plugins/ExpressionParser/Clang/CMakeLists.txt:52-62 links clangAST clangCodeGen clangFrontend clangParse clangSema clangSerialization

components.title: LLDB SB API, Python scripting and lldb-dap
components.one_line: The stable SB C++ API exported from liblldb, its SWIG Python bindings and scripting hooks, and the clients built only on it: the lldb driver and lldb-dap (Debug Adapter Protocol).
evidence: lldb/tools/lldb-dap/tool/CMakeLists.txt:5 LLDB_DAP_LINK_LIBS lldbDAP lldbHost lldbUtility liblldb

components.title: Testing: lit, FileCheck and the test-suite
components.one_line: The lit test runner and FileCheck that every subproject's regression tests run through, plus the out-of-tree llvm-test-suite and benchmarking guidance.

components.title: Build system: CMake, runtimes build, distributions
components.one_line: The CMake build for the monorepo (llvm/cmake/modules, cmake/Modules) and the runtimes build (runtimes/) that builds libc, libc++, compiler-rt, flang-rt, offload and openmp with the just-built compiler; cross-compilation, PGO and distribution recipes.
